failure.scope: The locked seed-3004 model completed generic and Liu rollout computations in memory, then stopped in an integrity-only endpoint-parity diagnostic before link decisions, seed outcome composition, raw arrays, sampled behavior, or result JSON were written. The failed attempt is noninterpretable and remains immutable.

cause: probability_metrics intentionally serializes a participant with an empty retained or omitted group as JSON null, while liu_endpoints retains the same value as floating NaN. The integrity-only parity diagnostic constructed the serialized side without dtype=float64, producing an object array and attempting None minus float. This is a representation mismatch in a diagnostic, not a difference between the registered probability estimands.

authorized_repair.numeric_change: Coerce both parity-diagnostic vectors to float64, so JSON null is restored to NaN, and compare the same finite paired entries with the existing NaN-omission rule.
authorized_repair.lifecycle_change: Retain the failed evaluation directory unchanged and route the complete three-seed replay through evaluation-attempt2. Add append-only source-repair provenance that verifies every unchanged original source and each exact replacement against its Git witness.
authorized_repair.qualification_change: Add a regression check containing an empty retained and an empty omitted participant, rerun the complete non-Liu CPU/CUDA qualification in attempt3, and lock that qualification with the repaired sources before replay.

unchanged: trained checkpoints and all training artifacts
architecture, model equations, access equations, and interventions
seeds, participants, task inputs, schedules, maps, and randomization
probability, causal-field, behavior, competence, and transport estimands
bootstrap rules, thresholds, four-link logic, nine behavior rules, and outcome tree
all-seed rule, transport trigger, claim boundary, and retention policy
replay_rule: After repaired-source qualification and an append-only source-repair lock are committed, evaluate all three locked seeds under attempt2 regardless of seed-3004 values. Do not retrain, replace, filter, extend, refit, or selectively continue any seed.
forbidden: overwriting or deleting the failed attempt
changing a scientific value, threshold, condition, or outcome rule
using the technical failure to inspect or tune a candidate
retraining or modifying the jointly locked artifacts
triggering item-count transport unless all three primary attempt2 replications pass
claim_boundary: This repair can only restore the registered evaluation path over the unchanged locked cohort. It cannot improve, reinterpret, rescue, or promote a scientific result.
